ns2:course.label: ABE Principles: Bioenvironment
ns2:course.description: Principles of environmental control for biological structures: psychrometrics; mass and heat transfer through buildings; ventilation requirements. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr Engineering & Agr Science or Agricultural & Biological Engr major(s).
